whenToUse: Lists, products, or documents searched by keyword.
People search for proper nouns or loanwords that are often misspelled.
whenNotToUse: Filters caused the empty result (use no filter results).
The screen has no data from the start (use an empty state).
A search server error (use an error state).

alternatives.name: Empty State
alternatives.reason: A first screen where nothing has been created yet.

alternatives.name: No Filter Results
alternatives.reason: The filter conditions are too narrow.

accessibility: Make the results area aria-live="polite" so the lack of results is read out.
Put the query in the title as typed so people can check what they searched.
Suggested queries are buttons that search again right away.
Clearing the query returns to the original list.
